cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 64% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.28% · WTI +2.04% · Brent -3.02% · NatGas +12.31%. 64% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +3.32%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Oilfield Services lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +3.32%; weakest is Oilfield Services at -2.35%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: VRT is the standout at +16.48%
cards.body: Leaders: VRT +16.48%, EOSE +7.14%, ARRY +5.01%, PWR +4.85%, BE +4.38%. Laggards: ENPH -16.03%, SEDG -8.30%, BKR -7.36%, NOV -6.23%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: ENPH moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: ENPH is -16.16% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.
